shortDescription: The Dow Jones Index decreased 95 points or 0.18 percent on Wednesday to close at 51575 points.The decline was led by Caterpillar (-3.31%), Nvidia (-3.22%) and Alphabet (-2.96%).On the upside, the strongest performers were UnitedHealth (4.86%), Merck (3.85%) and Walmart (3.33%).
